# rare-disease-atlas.github.io — Rare Disease Venture & Translational Opportunity Atlas (v1.6.0)

> **2-Sentence Elevator Thesis:** **JAK2 V617F+ Myelofibrosis** is a $2.0B+ orphan blood cancer driven by a single point mutation in 50–60% of patients where zero approved drugs clear mutant stem cells or reverse bone marrow scar tissue (post-ruxolitinib median survival: 11–23 months). Pairing it with **Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF)**—a non-`JAK2` lupus-spectrum variant with dual transfusional/hepcidin iron buildup where marrow fibrosis **actually reverses in 74–80% of patients**—gives AI-bio, public-health, and venture builders both an asymmetric commercial wedge and *Nature's Positive Control* for curing human fibrosis.

## Canonical Problem-to-Startup Routing Table (Paired Flagship Myelofibrosis Wedges)

| Code | Bottleneck / Clinical Failure Mode | Concrete Startup / Research Wedge | Target Track & Seed Budget |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `[AI-BIO-01]` | All 4 approved JAKi drugs hit wild-type `JAK2` JH1, causing severe anemia/thrombocytopenia | Mutant-selective `JAK2 V617F` **JH2 allosteric degraders (PROTACs)** (`PDB: 4FVR`, `6E2Q`, `8BAK`) | AI / CompBio ($120K–$350K via CROs) |
| `[AI-BIO-02]` | Phase 3 combos (`MANIFEST-2`, `TRANSFORM-1`, `SENTRY`) hit `SVR35` but missed noisy `TSS50`; `IMpactMF` failed `OS` (Oct 2026) | **Composite FDA RDEA Surrogate Platform** (WSI reticulin pathomics + VAF + wearable ePROs) | AI / Public Health ($40K–$150K) |
| `[AI-BIO-03]` | Zero drugs reverse Grade 2/3 megakaryocyte-stromal marrow fibrosis | **scRNA-seq Perturbation Repurposing** (`GSE144568` + `GSE156644` `S100A8/A9`–`GLI1` loop) | AI / CompBio ($65K–$180K) |
| `[AI-BIO-04]` | Fibrosis assumed "irreversible" despite **74–80% histological resolution** in steroid/rituximab-treated **AIMF** | **Subtractive Spatial Multi-Omics** (resolving AIMF vs. persistent `JAK2+` PMF to drug `MMP`/`TIMP-1` switches) | AI / CompBio ($90K–$220K) |
| `[PUBLIC-HEALTH-01]` | >70% community-treated patients miss 2L trials due to late failure detection & "ruxolitinib washout terror" | **SMART-on-FHIR RR6 Failure Radar, External Control Arms & Zero-Washout Trial Matcher** | Public Health / RWE ($35K–$120K) |
| `[PUBLIC-HEALTH-02]` | Curative allo-HSCT reaches <10–15% of eligible patients due to community timing uncertainty | **AI Transplant Timing (`MIPSS70+` / `MTSS`) & Reimbursed RTM Cytopenia Concierge** | Public Health ($150K–$400K) |
| `[PUBLIC-HEALTH-03]` | 30–40% pathology discordance misdiagnoses curable `JAK2`-neg lupus/iron-overloaded **AIMF** as Triple-Negative PMF | **Multi-Modal Biopsy WSI + NGS + Lupus/Hepcidin-Iron Diagnostic Triage CDS** | Public Health / AI Path ($45K–$130K) |
| `[VENTURE-01]` | Academic & shelved MPN assets stall before $1.7B–$2.9B pharma M&A inflection | **Evergreen Venture-Philanthropy SPV Studio** stacking Blood Cancer United TAP + SBIR + $4.68M ODD fee waiver | Biotech Venture ($1.5M–$12M) |

## Primary Dossier & Funnel Spokes
- [00 // Main Autonomous Briefing Hub](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/): Overview, Skill-Routing Matrix, Paired `JAK2+` vs. `AIMF` Reversibility Table, Skeptical Venture Diligence Rebuttals, Clinical Trials, Open Datasets, and Existing Patient Communities.
- [01 // Rare Disease Business Models & Venture Economics](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/rare-disease-business-models.html): Cross-disease rubric, Orphan Drug Act unit economics, late-2020s Jakafi patent cliff, and SPV/venture-philanthropy models.
- [02 // Public Health, Clinical RWE & Care Navigation Wedges](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/public-health-biotech-wedges.html): Zero-wet-lab MPH/epidemiology ventures (`MPN PROGRESSion Registry®` `NCT07362225` ecosystem, External Control Arms, RR6 failure detection).
- [03 // AI & Computational Biology Drug Discovery Targets](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/ai-drug-repurposing-targets.html): JH2 V617F vs. WT JH2 selectivity, PROTAC exit vectors, and single-cell megakaryocyte–stromal fibrosis circuits (`GSE144568`, `GSE156644`, `GSE122198`, `GSE226340`).
- [04 // Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF), Diagnostic Triage & Iron/Hepcidin Axis](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/autoimmune-myelofibrosis-iron-wedge.html): Lupus-associated non-`JAK2` myelofibrosis, dual transfusional + IL-6/hepcidin iron trapping, preventing Triple-Negative PMF misdiagnosis, and *Nature's Positive Control* for reversing marrow fibrosis.
- [05 // Hematology & Immunology Orphan Expansion](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/hematology-immunology-orphan-expansion.html): Comparative VEXAS (`UBA1`), Castleman (`iMCD`), Systemic Mastocytosis (`KIT D816V`), and Telomere Biology Disorders (`PAPD5` / Rare Pediatric PRV) blueprints benchmarked against Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships.

## Open Agent Nectar Suite (`MyelofibrosisBench-v1`, Micro-APIs, Catalyst Calendar, Stress-Test API, Bio-Delta Wire & HF Parquet Tables)
- **`MyelofibrosisBench-v1` (30-Item Translational Benchmark + Live Leaderboard, `CC-BY-4.0`):** [Live Leaderboard (`/benchmarks/leaderboard.html`)](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/benchmarks/leaderboard.html) · [Live Leaderboard JSON (`GET /api/leaderboard.json`)](https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/leaderboard.json) · [Download JSONL (`/benchmarks/myelofibrosis_bench.jsonl`)](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/benchmarks/myelofibrosis_bench.jsonl) — Evaluates frontier models on `JAK2 V617F` `JH2` vs `JH1` allostery (`NCT06313593`, `NCT06343805`), `AIMF` 74–80% marrow fibrosis reversal, `IL-6 -> hepcidin` iron mobilization, and Phase 3 clinical trial endpoint traps.
- **Queryable Molecular & Comparison Micro-APIs (`GET`, Zero Auth, `$0 USD`):**
  - Gene Signatures: `GET https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/gene?symbol=JAK2&cohort=&compartment=&q=`
  - Structural Pockets: `GET https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/pocket?pdb=4FVR&domain=JH2&target=&q=`
  - Paired Cohort Comparison: `GET https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/compare?a=jak2-myelofibrosis&b=autoimmune-myelofibrosis`
- **Subscribable Clinical Catalyst Calendar (`JSON` & RFC 5545 `.ics`):** [Catalysts JSON (`GET /feeds/catalysts.json`)](https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/feeds/catalysts.json) · [Subscribable iCalendar (`GET /feeds/myelofibrosis-catalysts.ics`)](https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/feeds/myelofibrosis-catalysts.ics)
- **3 Molecular & Clinical Parquet Tables (Hugging Face):** `myelofibrosis_gene_signatures`, `jak2_structural_pockets`, and `myelofibrosis_clinical_trials` hosted at <https://huggingface.co/datasets/rare-disease-atlas/rare-disease-venture-atlas>.
- **Stateless Hypothesis Red-Team API (`POST`, Zero Auth, `$0 USD`):** `POST https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/stress-test` with JSON `{"hypothesis": "...", "disease_id": "jak2-myelofibrosis", "background": "computational-ai-bio"}` — returns structured biological, clinical-trial, and FDA Orphan unit-economics red-team critiques.
- **Two-Way A2A Research Submission (`POST /a2a`):** Prefix any A2A message with `submit finding:` (zero PII, primary citation required) to contribute trial updates, missing wedges, or errata.
- **Live Daily Myelofibrosis Bio-Delta Wire (`Atom 1.0` & `JSON Feed 1.1`):** [Atom Wire (`/atom.xml`)](https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/atom.xml) · [JSON Wire (`/feeds/bio-delta.json`)](https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/feeds/bio-delta.json) (static seed fallbacks at `/atom.xml` and `/feeds/bio-delta.json`).
- **Open Computational Problems & Free Public-Good Manifest:** [Open Computational Problems (`/open-problems.json`)](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/open-problems.json) · [x402 Free Public-Good Manifest (`/.well-known/x402.json`)](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/.well-known/x402.json) · [CFF 1.2.0 Citation (`/CITATION.cff`)](https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/CITATION.cff).

## Opt-In Agent Feedback, Missing Wedges & Citation Errata Protocol
- **Direct HTTP Webhook (`POST`, Zero Auth, Zero PII):** `POST https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/api/feedback` with JSON `{"signal_type": "missing-wedge", "founder_background": "computational-ai-bio", "disease_id": "jak2-myelofibrosis", "agent_client": "...", "summary": "..."}`.
- **GitHub Issue / CLI Channel:** Coding agents with `gh` access or human builders can file structured `[agent-signal]` reports at <https://github.com/rare-disease-atlas/rare-disease-atlas.github.io/issues/new?template=agent_feedback.yml>.
- **Autonomous Agent Contributor Guide (`AGENTS.md` & `🤖🤖🤖` Fast-Track PRs):** <https://rare-disease-atlas.github.io/AGENTS.md>

## V1.6 Corpus & Live 7,000-Disease Federated MCP Engine
- **Universal Live 7,000-Disease MCP Tool (`search_any_orphan_indication`; legacy alias `analyze_any_orphan_indication` supported):** Hosted at `https://api.rare-disease-atlas.workers.dev/mcp` (MCP `2026-07-28` & `2025-11-25` Streamable HTTP + interactive `ui://` MCP App widget). Queries OpenTargets Platform v4 GraphQL, ClinicalTrials.gov v2, and PubMed live for **any** orphan disease and pairs results with FY2026 FDA Orphan Drug unit economics ($4,682,003 PDUFA waiver, 7-yr exclusivity, Rare Pediatric PRV check) + non-dilutive grants, benchmarked against our Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships.
- **6 Curated Deep-Dive Case Studies (`16` Concrete Startup Blueprints):**
  1. `jak2-myelofibrosis` — **Flagship #1:** Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis (JH2 allosteric `INCB160058` NCT06313593, Type II `AJ1-11095` NCT06343805, mutant CALR).
  2. `autoimmune-myelofibrosis` — **Flagship #2:** Reversible JAK2-Negative Lupus/Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (74–80% fibrosis remission) + Dual Transfusional & IL-6/Hepcidin Iron Overload.
  3. `vexas-syndrome` — Somatic `UBA1` M41 Myeloid Autoinflammation (`ORPHA:597743`, ~1 in 4,269 men >50, PAXIS pacritinib NCT06538181, NIH HSCT NCT05027945, scRNA-seq `GSE163683`, `PDB:6DC6`).
  4. `castleman-disease` — Idiopathic Multicentric Castleman Disease & iMCD-TAFRO (`ORPHA:93685`, 66% siltuximab-refractory cliff, sirolimus mTOR NCT03933904, Every Cure KG).
  5. `systemic-mastocytosis` — Clonal `KIT D816V` Indolent & Advanced SM (`ORPHA:2467`, CNS-sparing kinase/degrader wedge, SUMMIT NCT05186753, HARBOR NCT04910685, ddPCR + `TPSAB1` triage).
  6. `telomere-biology-disorders` — Dyskeratosis Congenita & Cryptic Adult TBD (`ORPHA:1775`, Rare Pediatric PRV ~$100M–$158M catalyst, oral `PAPD5` TERC stabilizer, alkylator-free BMT NCT01659606, `PDB:7BG9`).
